sections_target.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: First: Precautionary procedures
Make a direct connection (Jumper) between terminals (11,12,13,14) on both Test Plug type HP2-C4
Place both HP2-C4 Test Plug type in HR2A-C4 type Test Socket in I(87) Incoming, (87) M/C Bus to short the CT circuits
Second: Measuring the relay operating current setting value:
Remove the relay cover and withdraw the relay contact comb from the CT secondary terminals
Clean the relay and the cubicle with the air blower
Make a direct connection (Jumper) between terminals (11,12), (13,14), (15,16) on the CT side on Test Plug type XRT-1
Place Test Plug type XRT-1 in place of the contact comb inside the relay
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (5, 6) on Test Plug type XRT-1
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set
Raise the current gradually until you notice the upper relay disc for phase R move
Record the relay operating current value for phase R
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (7, 8) on Test Plug type XRT-1
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set
Raise the current gradually until you notice the middle relay disc for phase S move
Record the relay operating current value for phase S
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (9, 10) on Test Plug type XRT-1
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set
Raise the current gradually until you notice the lower relay disc for phase T move
Record the relay operating current value for phase T
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Third: Measuring the current-time relationship on phase R
Connect the Stop terminals from the Severker 650 injection set to terminals (1, 2) on the Test Plug
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (5, 6) on Test Plug XRT-1
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set
Set the injection current to twice the Setting Value
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Reset the time counter display on the Severker 650 injection set
Set the Severker 650 injection set switch to the (ON Time) position
Record the relay operating time corresponding to twice the Setting Value for phase R (note that the Severker 650 injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates)
Fourth: Measuring the current-time relationship on phase S
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (7, 8) on XRT-1 type Test Plug
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set
Set the injection current to twice the Setting Value
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Reset the time counter display on the Severker 650 injection set
Set the Severker 650 injection set switch to the (ON Time) position
Record the relay operating time corresponding to twice the Setting Value for phase S (note that the Severker 650 injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates)
Fifth: Measuring the current-time relationship on phase T
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (9, 10) on the XRT-1 test comb
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set
Set the injection current to twice the Setting Value
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Reset the time counter display on the Severker 650 injection set
Set the Severker 650 injection set switch to the (ON Time) position
Record the relay operating time corresponding to twice the Setting Value for phase T (note that the Severker 650 injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates)
Repeat steps 22 to 43 with the injection current set to 3 times the Setting Value
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Reset all the signals on the relay
Withdraw the XRT-1 type Test Plug from the relay
Fit the relay contact comb to the CT secondary terminals inside the relay
Fit the relay cover
Remove both HP2-C4 Test Plug type from Test Socket type HR2A-C4 in I(87) Incoming, (87) M/C Bus

Work Steps to be Carried Out
First: Precautionary procedures
Make a direct connection (Jumper) between terminals (11,12,13,14) on both Test Plug type HP2-C4 | 1.
Place both HP2-C4 Test Plug type in HR2A-C4 type Test Socket in I(87) Incoming, (87) M/C Bus to short the CT circuits | 2.
Second: Measuring the relay operating current setting value:
Remove the relay cover and withdraw the relay contact comb from the CT secondary terminals | 1.
Clean the relay and the cubicle with the air blower | 2.
Make a direct connection (Jumper) between terminals (11,12), (13,14), (15,16) on the CT side on Test Plug type XRT-1 | 3.
Place Test Plug type XRT-1 in place of the contact comb inside the relay | 4.
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (5, 6) on Test Plug type XRT-1 | 5.
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set | 6.
Raise the current gradually until you notice the upper relay disc for phase R move | 7.
Record the relay operating current value for phase R | 8.
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 9.
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (7, 8) on Test Plug type XRT-1 | 10.
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set | 11.
Raise the current gradually until you notice the middle relay disc for phase S move | 12.
Record the relay operating current value for phase S | 13.
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 14.
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (9, 10) on Test Plug type XRT-1 | 15.
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set | 16.
Raise the current gradually until you notice the lower relay disc for phase T move | 17.
Record the relay operating current value for phase T | 18.
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 19.
Third: Measuring the current-time relationship on phase R
Connect the Stop terminals from the Severker 650 injection set to terminals (1, 2) on the Test Plug | 1.
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (5, 6) on Test Plug XRT-1 | 2.
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set | 3.
Set the injection current to twice the Setting Value | 4.
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 5.
Reset the time counter display on the Severker 650 injection set | 6.
Set the Severker 650 injection set switch to the (ON Time) position | 7.
Record the relay operating time corresponding to twice the Setting Value for phase R (note that the Severker 650 injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates) | 8.
Fourth: Measuring the current-time relationship on phase S
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (7, 8) on XRT-1 type Test Plug | 1.
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set | 2.
Set the injection current to twice the Setting Value | 3.
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 4.
Reset the time counter display on the Severker 650 injection set | 5.
Set the Severker 650 injection set switch to the (ON Time) position | 6.
Record the relay operating time corresponding to twice the Setting Value for phase S (note that the Severker 650 injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates) | 7.
Fifth: Measuring the current-time relationship on phase T
Connect the current injection terminals to terminals (9, 10) on the XRT-1 test comb | 1.
Switch on the Severker 650 injection set | 2.
Set the injection current to twice the Setting Value | 3.
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 4.
Reset the time counter display on the Severker 650 injection set | 5.
Set the Severker 650 injection set switch to the (ON Time) position | 6.
Record the relay operating time corresponding to twice the Setting Value for phase T (note that the Severker 650 injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates) | 7.
Repeat steps 22 to 43 with the injection current set to 3 times the Setting Value | 8.
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 9.
Reset all the signals on the relay | 10.
Withdraw the XRT-1 type Test Plug from the relay | 11.
Fit the relay contact comb to the CT secondary terminals inside the relay | 12.
Fit the relay cover | 13.
Remove both HP2-C4 Test Plug type from Test Socket type HR2A-C4 in I(87) Incoming, (87) M/C Bus | 14.
